qualification: Authoring source and comparator checks only; independent scholarly review and reader testing have not occurred.
source_reading: Every selected original verse and its notes read before independent composition.
findings: Read all 719 original records and annotations before independent drafting; read all 719 TSW comparators afterward.
Preserved the widow’s children’s threatened enslavement, Naaman’s captive girl, violence against children and pregnant women, cannibalism, political killings, deportation and mutilation.
Retained Jehu’s own claims and the narrator’s qualifications separately. The actor in 9:33 was corrected from horses to Jehu to reflect the singular Hebrew verb.
Clarified 1:14 as two captains each with fifty men, and 6:10 as the king being on his guard after warnings.

Followed the read name Jehoaddan at 14:2 with the written Jehoaddin noted. Repositioned the difficult relative clause in 14:28 next to Damascus and Hamath so that it does not accidentally describe Israel.
Retained Amana, Jozabad, Berodach-baladan, Edomites at 16:6 and other pinned readings without harmonizing to other passages.

Kept the eighteenth/second-year notices about Jehoram, twelfth/eleventh-year notices about Ahaziah, Jotham’s twentieth year and sixteen-year reign, and Josiah’s peaceful-burial oracle beside his narrated death.
Preserved the lack of a named month in 25:3. Kept the books’ actual seven/eight/nineteen-year dates and the measured temple objects.
Retained poetry and divine first-person speech in 19:21–31 inside verse paragraphs. Kept the repeated warnings, remnant language and the mixed-worship tensions in chapter 17.
Reviewed all 49 verses at or above 0.90 overlap. Most are concise notices, accession dates or clear familiar speech. No minimum-change quota.
overlap_qualification: NFKC/casefold whole-verse word overlap is triage, not proof of fidelity, originality, legal uniqueness or comprehension. No change quota.
companion_impact: Changed wording invalidates earlier quote/text bindings for these chapters; reconcile during later Companion installation. No Companion files changed.
remaining_work: Whole-book Samuel and Kings authoring consistency passes remain queued; independent editorial review and reader testing remain pending.
